description: Searches live USPTO records for marks with this name, or lists an owner's marks. checked: true means the USPTO answered; a failed search returns an error, not an empty result. Federal records only.

classes.description: Nice classes to sort results by.

mark.description: The name to search. Leave it out to list an owner's marks.

owner.description: The applicant, to set their own marks apart. On its own, lists their marks.
